newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in london hit by selling pressure.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in london hit by selling pressure.

text.p: Japanese stocks trading in London were lower on Tuesday after the Nikkei plunged below the 19,000 level in Tokyo and took investors by surprise.
The Nikkei/Ise 50 index was off 25.28 points by 1425 GMT at 1,419.74 but dealers said trade was very quiet.
"We saw a big fall overnight," said one trader. "People in London were stunned and we've seen more selling pressure today."
The Nikkei 225 fell 549.81 points or 2.83 percent to close at 18,896.19, its lowest close since December 1995. The market was hit by lingering worries over the economy.
